findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms the maintenance and link loss, but does not cite the SITE_DOWN alarms for the specific sites S-SUD-006 and S-SUD-007.
The text of MW-0004 explicitly states the expected impact was downstream sites offline during splicing.
T5 and T6 both show S-SUD-006 and S-SUD-007 depend directly on LNK-SUD-02-A in the parent chain.
The timestamps for the alarms (02:52-05:36) fall within the maintenance window (02:47-05:48), confirming concurrency.
ALR-0012 states metrics dropped but does not specify that they dropped to zero.
